title: Lesson 23: Error Handling and Monitoring: Debug Logs, Event Monitoring, Health Checks, and Alerts
description: The observability layer of a Salesforce org: debug logs and trace flags when a transaction misbehaves, Event Monitoring when you need who, what, and when across the whole org, health checks for the security baseline and the platform status, and the alerting that turns all of it into action instead of archaeology.

options: Lesson 9 taught you how to design errors so nothing is silently dropped in an integration: idempotency, bounded retries, dead letters.
